adjustReputation(address,int32).notice: Adjust reputation after a settled payment. Called by the router only.

registerAgent(address,string).notice: Register `agent` as a payment receiver. `agent` is the address that receives funds and is looked up by payers; `msg.sender` becomes the `owner` allowed to manage the listing (supports both self-registration, where an agent calls this for itself, and custodial onboarding, where a relayer registers an agent address on its behalf via an off-chain API).
